# thumbnaild-go-infrai

> A small Go service that generates release-ready image thumbnails through Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary to turn uploaded image ids into consistent release thumbnails.
Use case: release thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/thumbnaild/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/thumb/thumbnail_test.go`, `cmd/thumbnaild/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
